answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: on a far bus home codemother's hook runs inside the far bus's post, so her reply stands before _announce_seals reads; a reply posted later is taken by the next far seal run, which reads every standing reply to tester. On the home bus reach holds the tester shim, which already receipts the reply, so the take is gated on remote_address() being set and the home path is unchanged.
